goal: Log descriptive error details and abort when disk space checks encounter filesystem errors
Avoids unhandled background thread crashes without diagnostics when storage media becomes unavailable
reviewability: Stale: no author activity for 64 days, so responses to review may take a long time
agreement: Disputed due to multiple objections against aborting inside low-level utilities
Unclean aborts prevent subsystems like the wallet or chainstate from cleanly flushing to disk (furszy)
Making termination policy decisions in low-level utilities prevents clean error propagation (josibake)
Bypasses top-level thread exception handling that could trigger an orderly shutdown (sedited)
Context-aware error handling is preferred over low-level context-free aborts (optout21)

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it addresses rare edge-case storage media failures during background disk space checks
Adds diagnostic logging on I/O errors, but the failure condition is infrequent and deferrable
